tools.description: Search Python source files in /testbed for a literal string or regular expression, returning file paths, line numbers, and surrounding context. Use it to locate exception raise sites, option names, and related code before editing.
tools.label: Search Python source code
tools.name: search_source_code

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-200).

path_include.description: Optional substring that must appear in the relative file path.

query.description: Text to find in Python source files.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression.
